description: Source code for version and configuration information in the ATen component of PyTorch, including functions to retrieve versions of MKL, MKL-DNN, OpenMP, CPU capabilities, and build configuration details.

methods.name: get_mkl_version
methods.description: Retrieves the version string of MKL if enabled.

methods.name: get_mkldnn_version
methods.description: Retrieves the version string of MKL-DNN if enabled.

methods.name: get_openmp_version
methods.description: Retrieves the version of OpenMP if available.

methods.name: get_cpu_capability
methods.description: Determines the CPU capability based on environment and compile-time definitions.

methods.name: used_cpu_capability
methods.description: Returns a string indicating the CPU capability usage.

methods.name: show_config
methods.description: Generates a string describing the build configuration and environment.

methods.name: get_cxx_flags
methods.description: Returns C++ compiler flags used in the build, with special handling if built with FBCODE_CAFFE2.
